actionResult.summary: Review 209 Apply：实现与正式 Change Verification 满足 207/208 approved contract，G1 7/7 correctness 与 real OpenSpec physical closure 均成立；Reviewer targeted rerun 在当前环境观察到 G1 7/7、69 real CLI invocations、约 33.15s，确认低于 baseline 79。209 verification publication 与 terminal binding 精确一致，selected Node logical scopes 在 executor 中 union/dedupe 后只物理执行一次，并非 verification.md 中相同 command 的四次重复执行。首次 209 formal admission 超过 detached 外层 240s、随后 same-Run continuation 成功，未破坏 durable state，因此当前不足以构成 H1 blocking defect；但该现象显示 formal Change Verification wall time 对执行环境/资源竞争敏感，应在 canonical/local 环境、02 Delivery Full Test 前进行一次干净复测并记录总 wall time 与 Node union/typecheck/OpenSpec 分项。

reviewFindings.title: formal Change Verification wall time 对执行环境敏感，需在 canonical/local 环境继续量化
reviewFindings.problem: 首次 209 formal admission 在 detached 外层调用窗口超过 240s，随后同一 pending Run continuation/retry 才完成。当前 executor 已确认会把 tests-cli/tests-execution/tests-openspec-runtime/tests-verification 先 union/dedupe 为一次 Node physical execution，因此这不是四次重复 subprocess；209 最终 formal Verification 也在未扩大 timeout/concurrency、未跳过 real OpenSpec 的前提下 PASS，same Run/persistence 未损坏，所以不违反 207 frozen Change acceptance。Reviewer targeted rerun 的独立 G1 单文件结果为 7/7 PASS、69 real CLI invocations、约 33.15s；但 formal union 在受限 detached host 上表现出明显资源/时延敏感性。
reviewFindings.invariant: Change-level acceptance must preserve correctness and bounded process work without inventing an unapproved absolute wall-clock SLA; Delivery Full Test remains a later Owner-authorized boundary.
evidence: 209 verification.md status=passed and terminalBinding fingerprint matches exactly.

reviewFindings.impact: Not a current H1 correctness/lifecycle blocker, but execution-context sensitivity could make later canonical/Delivery verification unexpectedly slow and should be measured before Owner-authorized Delivery Full Test.
